Electrical BOD states 'The facilities shall be 36,000 square feet, which excludes the thickness of the exterior walls'

conflict_flags.rationale: The 37,586 SF figure from the BOD General section represents gross building area including wall thickness. The 36,000 SF figure from the SOW and Electrical BOD represents net interior area excluding wall thickness. The discrepancy is ~4.5% and is explicitly explained by the SOW language 'excludes the thickness of the exterior walls.' Both claims are consistent with each other when the measurement basis is understood. Chose 37,586 GSF as the primary gross area figure.
